card.name: British-spelling web prose, mixed words
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in British-style web and news text, such as "the" after "get", commas after hospital names, "al" in citations, and month names in references. No single word type unites them.

modes.label: Function words in UK prose
modes.description: Small words like "the", "to" or "later" inside British-written educational or news sentences.

modes.label: Citation and affiliation bits
modes.description: Pieces of references and institution names such as "al", a month, or "University".

card.writes: It nudges the model toward British spellings and forms such as "whilst", "recognised" and "personalised", and away from American ones.
card.plain: It marks British-English web writing and pushes the model to use UK spellings.
